timing.dac_trial_update: posedge clk in S_SET_TRIAL; dac_code changes to trial_code | selected_bit
timing.sample_offset: posedge clk at trial_update_cycle + 3 clock periods
timing.settling_interval: 2 complete clk periods after the DAC update edge

transaction.adc_out_commit: adc_out receives the final decided code on the LSB sampling edge
transaction.bit_order: MSB to LSB, exactly once each
transaction.busy: busy rises on start acceptance and falls on the same edge done rises
transaction.decision: sampled comparator applies to the currently selected trial bit
transaction.done: done rises on the next rising edge after the final comparator sample and stays high for one clk period
transaction.first_trial: MSB trial is registered at the second rising edge after start acceptance
transaction.reset: asynchronous active-low reset clears all controller outputs and state
transaction.start_acceptance: start is sampled high in S_IDLE at a rising clk edge; busy rises on that edge
